12:- 2026-09-29T19:52:55.452+00:00 · user · Interval 08 changes the program again. I rechecked the standing repositories first: remote CRX remains 6c4b531, remote PING remains 81b3248, and piging2/fyd remains inaccessible through the connected GitHub API. So I treat the Interval 08 results as Pig-local operational evidence, not remote-repository evidence. The important result isn't merely “GREEN.” We now have three consecutive capabilities that compose: UNDERSTAND → EXPLAIN WHY → OWNER CORRECTS → CORRECTION SURVIVES → AUTHORIZED ACTION → INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED EFFECT → OUTCOME WINDOW That's enough to stop treating FYD as primarily a website generator. The first primitive version of the closed-loop operating system for a business is actually visible. My decisions on the remaining security issues Authorize the public-history purge — but only as a controlled security operation, not immediately mixed into product convergence. The credentials are already dead/rotated, so this is no longer emergency containment. History rewriting cannot un-expose a compromised credential; its purpose now is reducing persistent exposure and preventing accidental reuse/scanning. Before execution, require the exact affected refs/commits, backup/recovery point, rewrite mapping, force-push implications, collaborator/fork consequences, and post-rewrite secret scan. Then perform it as an isolated operation. Do not rewrite unrelated repository history. Reset the OAuth client secret: YES. Treat it as completion of credential hygiene. If the provider requires your interactive Cloud Console authorization, that is the legitimate blocker; don't fabricate automation around it. Rotate it, update only the authorized secret store/consumers, verify the replacement, invalidate the previous secret, and never commit the new value. The stash is now the highest-priority repository-convergence problem Do not apply it wholesale. Twenty-one differing files means potentially stranded paid-for implementation, collisions, or superseded work. The previous accidental git stash doesn't change ownership. Preserve it exactly where it is and perform archaeology without mutation. Classify every file into the existing dirty-tree dispositions: ACTIVE-WIP REFERENCE HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED GENERATED/DISPOSABLE COLLISION/UNKNOWN SECRET-BLOCKED Then ask the more important question for each ACTIVE-WIP file: WHAT CAPABILITY EXISTS HERE THAT DOES NOT EXIST ON THE SERVED LINE? If the answer is none: SUPERSEDED. If unique and valuable: harvest the semantic unit, not “the stash.” If ownership can't be established: COLLISION/UNKNOWN and leave untouched. No stash pop. No blanket apply. No cleanup merely to make git status pretty. Fix the bare “on hold” blind spot now This one qualifies as a minimal reached correctness fix. The authority gate has just demonstrated a false-positive fix, while retaining eight real restriction markers. A known false-negative for bare on hold means the gate can now look green when the controlling prose actually expresses a restriction. Do not add "on hold" as a naive substring if that recreates the false-positive class you just eliminated. Use the same semantic/contextual rule established by the gate fix and add adversarial pairs such as: DENY: "deployment is on hold" "this action remains on hold" "publishing is currently on hold" ALLOW: "report on hold duration" "documentation describes the on-hold state" "test fixture verifies 'on hold' handling" "the old on-hold restriction was removed" The principle is: restriction state, not restriction vocabulary. Commit that atomically. Interval 09 should be the learning interval Don't respond to P2 becoming green by constructing a learning architecture. Use the Facebook action you already have. The system currently knows: INTENT → AUTHORIZED ACTION → VERIFIED EFFECT → NO SIGNAL YET That last state is excellent. NO SIGNAL is not FAILURE. We need the temporal outcome state machine before we need sophisticated learning: PENDING_WINDOW ↓ NO_SIGNAL_YET ↓ ┌──────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────┐ POSITIVE NEUTRAL NEGATIVE OUTCOME OUTCOME OUTCOME And potentially: INCONCLUSIVE CONFOUNDED UNOBSERVABLE Do not let a model turn absence of evidence into a negative reward. Send the coordinator this INTERVAL 09 — OUTCOME → LEARNING Interval 07 proved owner-governed understanding. Interval 08 proved: INTENT → AUTHORIZATION → ATTEMPT → VERIFIED EFFECT → OUTCOME WINDOW. DO NOT REOPEN THOSE ARCHITECTURES. They are regression invariants. SECURITY COMPLETION PUBLIC HISTORY PURGE: AUTHORIZED CONDITIONALLY. First produce the exact rewrite set: AFFECTED REPOSITORY AFFECTED REFS AFFECTED COMMITS SECRET PATHS RECOVERY POINT REWRITE MAP REMOTE/FORK CONSEQUENCES POST-REWRITE SCAN No unrelated history rewriting. Credential rotation already provides containment. History purge is exposure reduction. Execute separately from product commits. OAUTH CLIENT SECRET RESET: AUTHORIZED. If interactive provider access is required, STOP at that boundary and report the exact human action. Never expose replacement material. REPOSITORY ARCHAEOLOGY Preserve the 21-file stash. DO NOT POP/APPLY IT WHOLESALE. For every file determine: OWNERSHIP SEMANTIC CAPABILITY DIFF FROM SERVED LINE REACHED? ALREADY REPRESENTED? DEPENDENCIES SECRETS? Then classify: ACTIVE-WIP REFERENCE HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED GENERATED/DISPOSABLE COLLISION/UNKNOWN SECRET-BLOCKED. Target: ZERO UNCLASSIFIED FILES. Not zero files. Harvest unique value semantic-unit by semantic-unit. AUTHORITY GATE Close the known bare on hold false-negative. Preserve the Interval-08 false-positive correction. Test restriction meaning rather than naive vocabulary. Adversarially prove both: REAL HOLD → DENY and: PROSE ABOUT HOLD → ALLOW. Atomic commit. P0 — OUTCOME SEMANTICS Search FYD and PING first. Search harvested systems only for a demonstrated missing primitive. Do not create an OutcomeAuthority unless an existing authority cannot own the transition. Starting fixture: the real Interval-08 Facebook action. Preserve: INTENT AUTHORIZATION ATTEMPT WORKER RESULT INDEPENDENT EFFECT VERIFICATION OUTCOME OBSERVATION. Required distinction: NO SIGNAL YET ≠ FAILURE. Determine the minimum existing representation for: PENDING_WINDOW POSITIVE NEUTRAL NEGATIVE INCONCLUSIVE UNOBSERVABLE only where the product genuinely needs those distinctions. Do not invent a universal reward ontology. OUTCOME ATTRIBUTION Before learning from an outcome answer: WHAT CHANGED? WHAT WAS OBSERVED? OVER WHAT WINDOW? WHAT BASELINE EXISTS? WHAT OTHER ACTIONS OCCURRED? IS ATTRIBUTION SUPPORTED OR MERELY CORRELATED? The system may record: ACTION FOLLOWED BY OUTCOME. It may not silently upgrade that to: ACTION CAUSED OUTCOME. LEARNING Learning produces candidates, not authority. Flow: VERIFIED OUTCOMES → PATTERN → CANDIDATE LEARNING → SUPPORT SET → CONFIDENCE / APPLICABILITY → PROPOSAL → EXISTING AUTHORIZATION BOUNDARY → DETERMINISTIC POLICY A model may discover the pattern. A model may explain the pattern. A model may propose the rule. A model may not silently promote its own rule. REVERSE-ENGINEER INTELLIGENCE INTO SOFTWARE This is now an explicit product objective. Whenever an intelligent decision repeatedly succeeds, ask: CAN THIS DECISION NOW BECOME DETERMINISTIC SOFTWARE? Example: first: LLM decides whether customer question is pricing-related. after evidence: tested deterministic classifier/rule handles obvious cases with model fallback for ambiguity. Or: first: model chooses placement. later: observed outcomes establish deterministic placement policy for known workload classes. Desired direction: MODEL-REQUIRED → MODEL-ASSISTED → DETERMINISTIC DEFAULT + MODEL ESCALATION where evidence supports the transition. Never force determinism where ambiguity remains irreducible. MISSION CONTROL Begin exposing the closed loop for PING using existing state. It should be possible to answer: WHAT DID PING ASK FOR? WHAT DID WE DO? WHO AUTHORIZED IT? DID IT ACTUALLY HAPPEN? WHAT HAPPENED AFTERWARD? WHAT DO WE THINK WE LEARNED? HOW CERTAIN ARE WE? HAS THAT LEARNING BECOME POLICY? This is a projection. Mission Control does not become another authority. DO NOT BUILD No generic reinforcement-learning system. No reward-model training. No generic analytics platform. No autonomous policy promotion. No vector-memory system. No new agent framework. No new infrastructure provider. No reopening correction survival. No reopening portability merely because it passed. INTERVAL 09 LEDGER Answer only: 1. SECURITY Is repository exposure reduced as authorized, and is OAuth rotation complete or blocked at an explicit human boundary? 2. STRANDED VALUE What is inside the 21-file stash, and how much unique valuable implementation remains? 3. OUTCOME Did the Interval-08 action move from NO SIGNAL YET to a supported outcome state, or does the observation window honestly remain open? 4. LEARNING Did one evidence-backed candidate learning emerge without being silently promoted to authority? 5. PRODUCT Can Mission Control now show one complete PING chain: INTENT → AUTHORIZATION → VERIFIED EFFECT → OUTCOME → CANDIDATE LEARNING? If no new reached capability entered the product: NO SUBSTANTIATED INTEGRATION PROGRESS THIS PERIOD. There is also a subtle success in Interval 08 worth protecting: “no-signal outcome with the window honestly left open” is better than manufacturing a success metric. That's exactly the epistemic discipline we want. Once we can observe enough of those loops, ORCA can become progressively less dependent on model judgment. The model discovers; evidence accumulates; software crystallizes the stable portions; the model remains for genuinely novel or ambiguous decisions. That is the practical route to the thing you've been describing as reverse-engineering an intelligent assistant into deterministic software—not by cloning a model, but by continuously converting repeated, evidenced judgment into explicit, testable, replayable capability.The evidence changes the priority. Do not let Interval 08 security cleanup, Cloudflare, R2, portability, or the public-social research pull FYD back into infrastructure expansion. The read-only archaeology found useful future seams, but it also found the exact trap: Cloudflare is net-new, object storage is net-new, placement reconciliation is net-new, and there are three competing event shapes. Pipeline: NATURAL LANGUAGE ↓ TYPED SITE PATCH ↓ VALIDATE ↓ BEFORE/AFTER PREVIEW ↓ OWNER APPROVAL ↓ EVENT ↓ SITE SPEC PROJECTION ↓ RENDER. Do not let the model directly edit JSX. That is the website-builder breakthrough. Use these defaults when the builder lane reaches media. PUBLIC SITE MEDIA: YES — treat clearly public site media for these authorized demo sites as eligible for acquisition for the demo, subject to provenance and source rights. IDENTITY OBJECT RELATIONSHIP EVIDENCE CAPABILITY OWNER DECISION TRANSITION OUTCOME. What MAY vary: renderer storage placement social protocol LLM crawler browser hosting search engine agent provider. 21:- 2026-09-29T21:05:47.291+00:00 · user · The framework corpus supports the direction, but the harvest should be selective and subordinate to TenantOS/PING’s existing authorities. MatrixClaw’s external-agent boundary is especially aligned: its core owns session/history/approvals while Codex or Claude owns only its external thread/process protocol. GitHub Talos independently reinforces the same rule—model proposes, deterministic kernel authorizes exact effects. GitHub Nerve’s plan→approve→execute and proposed-skill lifecycle is useful for learning candidates, not as another planner authority. GitHub There are also useful but lower-level harvests: ClawDesk explicitly implements checkpoints, leases, an activity journal and DLQ; Goated demonstrates how thin an external-runtime supervisor can be when Codex/Claude own their own context; ThinClaw is useful for extension trust classes; ForkScout has concrete restart/orphan-recovery mechanics; and Wayland demonstrates the Mission Control projection UX. GitHub But the uploaded analysis is right about the governing constraint: do not turn these into 16 TenantOS frameworks. Harvest them as a corpus of mechanisms and tests. Pasted markdown Send this: : TENANTOS — HARVEST THE AGENT ECOSYSTEM, DO NOT IMPORT IT We now have a useful corpus: Pioneer AgentArk POLYROB ForkScout Talos MatrixClaw Hivekeep Pernix Nerve MyAgens Goated ShibaClaw ThinClaw AgentOS ClawDesk Wayland. DO NOT IMPLEMENT 16 INTEGRATIONS. DO NOT ADD ANOTHER ORCHESTRATOR. DO NOT ADD ANOTHER EVENT BUS. DO NOT ADD ANOTHER MEMORY AUTHORITY. DO NOT ADD ANOTHER PLANNER AUTHORITY. We are harvesting MECHANISMS. ============================================================ FIRST PRINCIPLE TenantOS should become the constitutional operating layer ABOVE interchangeable intelligence/execution runtimes. The future optionality is: TenantOS │ ├── Codex ├── Claude Code ├── Hermes ├── native JS ├── Python workers ├── Ollama/local ├── remote workers ├── MCP tools └── future runtimes WITHOUT any runtime becoming canonical truth. The runtime is a HAND. TenantOS owns AUTHORITY. ============================================================ CURRENT TENANTOS AUTHORITIES WIN Before creating anything new, map harvested mechanisms onto: Identity Tenant / Namespace Event Mission Capability Approval Execution Evidence Outcome Projection. If an existing authority can own it: EXTEND IT. Do not create: AgentAuthority SwarmAuthority LearningAuthority PlannerAuthority ExternalAgentAuthority MemoryAuthority RuntimeEventAuthority. ============================================================ HARVEST 1 — EXTERNAL RUNTIME BOUNDARY PRIMARY REFERENCE: MatrixClaw. HARVEST THE PATTERN: core owns session/control state external runtime owns external process/thread adapter normalizes runtime-specific events. SEARCH PING/TenantOS FIRST. We want the smallest equivalent of: ExecutionRuntimeRegistry and: ExternalRuntimeAdapter. Conceptual contract only: availability() descriptor() start(work) resume(execution) send(input) interrupt() close() events() DO NOT copy this interface blindly. Derive it from existing ExecutionAdapter/ExecutionAuthority contracts. ============================================================ CRITICAL OWNERSHIP External runtime MAY own: process thread ID provider-specific session ID runtime context provider protocol. External runtime MUST NOT own: tenant identity mission truth authorization truth canonical event identity approval truth outcome truth promotion truth capability truth. ============================================================ HARVEST 2 — NORMALIZED EXECUTION EVENTS MatrixClaw normalizes external-agent events. Good pattern. TenantOS needs ONE execution vocabulary regardless of worker. Search existing event types first. Determine whether we already represent: EXECUTION_STARTED MESSAGE/OUTPUT TOOL_REQUESTED TOOL_STARTED TOOL_COMPLETED DIFF_PROPOSED EXECUTION_COMPLETED EXECUTION_FAILED EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED. Do NOT create another event schema. Map runtime-native events into existing canonical/event semantics. Keep raw provider payload only as diagnostic/evidence where justified. ============================================================ HARVEST 3 — DETERMINISTIC CAPABILITY GRANTS PRIMARY REFERENCE: Talos. Its strongest idea is not "agent security." It is: MODEL PROPOSES DETERMINISTIC SYSTEM AUTHORIZES. That is already our architecture. Strengthen CapabilityAuthority rather than replacing it. Investigate scoped grants binding: tenant actor mission execution worker capability resource argument digest expiry attempt. Do not implement this exact shape until mapped against existing grants. Key invariant: AN LLM NEVER DECIDES WHETHER ITS OWN EFFECT IS AUTHORIZED. ============================================================ HARVEST 4 — DURABLE EXECUTION PRIMARY REFERENCES: ClawDesk ForkScout POLYROB Nerve. Harvest TESTABLE INVARIANTS around: leases attempt numbers checkpointing retry dead-letter orphan detection resume interrupt crash recovery circuit breaking blue-green worker promotion. We already have Mission/Run/Execution infrastructure. Strengthen it. Do not replace it. ============================================================ EXECUTION STATE MUST DISTINGUISH INTENDED AUTHORIZED LEASED STARTED CHECKPOINTED SUCCEEDED FAILED UNKNOWN CANCELLED. Do not blindly adopt these names. First map current states. Especially attack UNKNOWN. A machine crash after external effect but before durable receipt must NOT be called FAILED. ============================================================ HARVEST 5 — THIN SUPERVISION PRIMARY REFERENCE: Goated. Important lesson: DO NOT DUPLICATE WHAT CODING RUNTIMES ALREADY DO WELL. Codex/Claude can own: their context management their compaction their internal tool loop their provider protocol. TenantOS should not wrap them so heavily that we reproduce them. TenantOS supplies: mission bounded context capabilities workspace authorization receipts outcomes. Then gets out of the way. ============================================================ HARVEST 6 — EXTENSION TRUST CLASSES PRIMARY REFERENCE: ThinClaw. Harvest the distinction between: native trusted implementation sandboxed extension MCP service sidecar external runtime remote service. Do NOT treat all tools as equivalent. But map trust classes into CapabilityAuthority. Example question: Can this execution: READ FILE? WRITE FILE? NETWORK? SPAWN PROCESS? USE SECRET? PUBLISH EXTERNALLY? SPEND MONEY? The answer comes from capabilities. Not from the runtime's self-description. ============================================================ HARVEST 7 — LEARNING CANDIDATES PRIMARY REFERENCES: AgentArk Nerve Pernix POLYROB. THE IMPORTANT IDEA: successful repeated behavior can create a CANDIDATE improvement. It cannot silently become policy. Pipeline: OUTCOMES ↓ REPEATED PATTERN ↓ CANDIDATE ↓ SUPPORTING EVIDENCE ↓ COUNTEREXAMPLES ↓ PROPOSAL ↓ REVIEW / EXISTING AUTHORITY ↓ PROMOTION ↓ VERSIONED POLICY/SKILL. Search PING first for existing proposal/promotion/evidence structures. Do not create LearningAuthority. ============================================================ SKILLS ARE NOT TRUTH Nerve/Pernix progressive skill loading is useful. Harvest: small metadata always available instructions loaded when relevant resources loaded only when needed. This can reduce context cost enormously. But a skill is: PROCEDURAL KNOWLEDGE. Not: canonical fact owner preference authorization outcome. Keep those boundaries explicit. ============================================================ HARVEST 8 — RUNTIME FAILOVER PRIMARY REFERENCES: MyAgens POLYROB. Useful: one task can potentially execute on multiple compatible runtimes. But NEVER make failover semantically invisible when effects may have already occurred. Safe: model provider failed BEFORE effect → retry compatible provider. Dangerous: worker timed out AFTER external mutation → blindly retry. Therefore failover must consult execution/effect state. ============================================================ HARVEST 9 — MISSION CONTROL PRIMARY REFERENCES: Wayland AgentArk MyAgens. DO NOT import their control planes. Harvest UX questions. Mission Control should answer: WHAT IS RUNNING? WHAT IS WAITING? WHAT FAILED? WHO OWNS IT? WHICH RUNTIME HAS IT? WHAT WAS AUTHORIZED? WHAT EFFECT OCCURRED? WHAT EVIDENCE EXISTS? WHAT OUTCOME FOLLOWED? WHAT LEARNING WAS PROPOSED? WHAT REQUIRES HUMAN DECISION? Mission Control remains: PROJECTION. NOT AUTHORITY. ============================================================ HARVEST 10 — MULTI-AGENT COMMUNICATION Hivekeep and other multi-agent systems demonstrate persistent specialist identities and inter-agent messaging. DO NOT build an agent social network. TenantOS already has the better abstraction: Mission → bounded delegated work → Execution → result/evidence. When Agent A asks Agent B for work: that should become observable delegated execution. Not invisible chat. ============================================================ HARVEST 11 — OWNER INBOX POLYROB and several others converge on a useful UX pattern: SHOW THE HUMAN ONLY WHAT NEEDS A DECISION. This fits TenantOS extremely well. Future Mission Control should have: NEEDS YOU where each item states: WHAT HAPPENED WHY YOU ARE NEEDED CONSEQUENCE AVAILABLE DECISIONS DEFAULT IF YOU DO NOTHING. This may be more important than a giant agent dashboard. ============================================================ HARVEST 12 — DOCTOR / PREFLIGHT Several projects implement useful environment checks. TenantOS should eventually have one deterministic preflight path. Before execution: runtime available? credentials resolvable? workspace valid? capabilities resolvable? dependencies healthy? target reachable? required adapter compatible? NO AI. Deterministic software. ============================================================ THE MOST IMPORTANT CURRENT QUESTION DO NOT START CODING THIS YET. FIRST FORENSIC: WHAT DOES TENANTOS ALREADY HAVE? Produce one matrix: MECHANISM EXISTING TENANTOS IMPLEMENTATION CURRENT CALLERS TESTS HARVEST REFERENCE GAP ACTION. Actions ONLY: KEEP STRENGTHEN WRAP MERGE DELETE DEFER. ============================================================ SEARCH THESE EXISTING PING/TENANTOS AREAS MissionRuntime MissionScheduler WorkerRuntime ExecutionAuthority ExecutionAdapter ContainerExecutionAdapter AIRuntime CapabilityAuthority UnifiedEventRuntime event bridge event governance identity evidence witness outcome projection Mission Control skills MCP external runtimes agent registry provider routing. SEARCH CODE BEFORE DOCS. SEARCH CALLERS. SEARCH TESTS. SEARCH GIT HISTORY. ============================================================ EVENT AUTHORITY — DO NOT TOUCH UNTIL PROVEN We still need exactly one answer: WHO OWNS: CREATE → CANONICALIZE → ID → HASH → APPEND → SEQUENCE → DURABLE COMMIT → STREAM → REPLAY? Do not bring another framework's event store into TenantOS. Use these frameworks only as falsification references. If existing TenantOS has three partial owners: CONVERGE THEM. Do not create number four. ============================================================ LICENSE GATE FOR EVERY HARVEST: record: REPOSITORY LICENSE COMMIT/SHA FILES STUDIED MECHANISM COPY / ADAPT / CLEAN-ROOM PATTERN DEPENDENCY COST. Especially do not copy GPL code into proprietary components without an explicit licensing decision. Patterns are not permission to copy implementation. ============================================================ DO NOT "WORK ALL FRAMEWORKS INTO TENANTOS" THAT PHRASE IS DANGEROUS. Instead: WORK THE BEST MECHANISMS INTO THE EXISTING TENANTOS MODEL. A framework that contributes no superior mechanism gets: REJECT.
